diagnostic  E3 PASSED AND E4 FAILED WITH THE SIGN REVERSED, in every fold. That
asks for an explanation of E3 rather than a celebration of it. The
hypothesis was study bias, and THE DIAGNOSTIC DOES NOT SUPPORT IT:
mean BioGRID degree of a drug's targets vs its side-effect count +0.1449
pair mean degree vs -separation                                  +0.2197
-separation vs side-effect overlap, degree partialled out        +0.0698
Degree is genuinely tied to both halves, so the confound is real -- but
removing it leaves E3 essentially untouched, +0.0720 -> +0.0698. Study bias is
NOT what E3 was measuring, and the tidy story has to be dropped.
What does move it is the count-and-frequency baseline, which alone
accounts for R2 0.5685 of side-effect overlap. Take that out and
proximity flips sign. So the raw positive rides on how MANY side effects
each drug has -- the same confound that has failed this row since loop 12,
reappearing in a design built specifically to be immune to it.

THE ANSWER IS NO, AND THE WAY IT IS NO IS THE USEFUL PART. Shared targets do predict
shared side effects (+0.0624 against 0.0130), which is a lookup. On the 190,502 pairs with
no target in common, network separation clears its null (+0.0720 vs 0.0570) --
and then REVERSES to -0.0539 once each drug's side-effect count and the population
frequency of the terms are removed, in all five held-out folds, mean -0.0617.
A sign that stable is not noise. The obvious explanation was study bias -- well-studied
proteins have more edges and more recorded effects -- and IT IS THE WRONG ONE. Degree
does track both halves (+0.1449 to side-effect count, +0.2197 to -separation), but
partialling it out moves E3 from +0.0720 to +0.0698, which is nothing. The tidy story is dropped.
What actually carries the raw positive is how MANY side effects each drug has: the
count-and-frequency baseline alone accounts for R2 0.5685 of side-effect overlap,
and once it is removed proximity reverses. THAT IS THE SAME CONFOUND THAT HAS FAILED
THIS ROW SINCE LOOP 12, reappearing inside a design built specifically to be immune
to it -- it entered through the outcome instead of the predictor. Reformulating from
HOW MANY to WHICH was right and was not sufficient; the row stays 3-of-4 and this is
recorded as a negative rather than retried until something passes.
